title: Axiom harness coverage for Gf2mWide<4> (GF(2^256))
description:
Close the 6fb4abad story's first success criterion: `Gf2mWide<4>` passes the full field axiom harness.

## Scope

- Add `pub fn gf2m_wide_strategy<const N: usize, Cfg: Gf2mWideConfig<N>>() -> BoxedStrategy<Gf2mWide<N, Cfg>>` to `crates/gf2-core/src/field/axiom_tests.rs` (mirror `gf2m_u128_strategy`). Generates 2N random u64s, packs as `[u64; N]`, calls `Gf2mWide::new` (which tail-masks to `Cfg::M`).
- `#[test] fn test_axioms_gf2m_wide_256()` → `test_field_axioms(gf2m_wide_strategy::<4, Gf2m256TestConfig>(), 2)`. Use `test_field_axioms` (not `test_const_field_axioms`) because `order()` overflows at M=256 per Task 4.
- `#[test] fn test_const_field_zero_one_gf2m_wide_256()` asserts `Gf2mWide::<4, Gf2m256TestConfig>::zero().is_zero()` and `one().is_one()` (skip the `order()` assertion).
- Respect 60s workspace-test budget: use `ProptestConfig::with_cases(100)` locally (~200 ms wall-clock) rather than the harness default 1000.
- `#[test] #[ignore] fn test_axioms_gf2m_wide_256_stress()` at 1000 cases for manual runs.
- Stretch (PR-body only, no blocker): `#[cfg(feature = "slow-tests")]`/`#[ignore]` smoke for `N = 8`.
- Do NOT modify `test_const_field_axioms`.

## Success criteria

- Axiom harness passes for `Gf2mWide<4, Gf2m256TestConfig>`.
- Full suite completes in ≤60s.
- `cargo fmt`/`cargo clippy -- -D warnings`/`cargo test --release` clean.
